profile.stagger_pattern: Six council seats, nonpartisan at-large, four-year staggered terms with three council seats elected every two years (even years). The mayor is elected separately to a TWO-year term every even year. Class 1 seats (labelled At-Large A/B/C here) were elected 2018, 2022 and 2026; Class 2 seats (At-Large D/E/F) were elected 2020 and 2024. Terms run November to November. Under A.R.S. 9-821.01(D) a candidate winning a majority in the August/July primary is elected outright and does not appear on the November ballot - this is what Page does in practice: the entire 2018 council slate, the 2022 mayor and council slate, the 2024 mayor and the 2026 slate were all decided at the primary.
profile.election_month: August primary (July from 2024/2026), November general only for races not decided at the primary

run_log.detail: Registry AZ entry re-verified. CONFIRMED DEAD/CHANGED: (1) Coconino County (coconino.az.gov) is not merely robots-disallowed - it now sits behind Cloudflare and returns a challenge page to curl with a browser UA and HTTP 403 to WebFetch, on /robots.txt, /1120/Election-Results and /205/Past-Election-Results alike. Unusable by any tool available here. (2) lakepowellchronicle.com does NOT 403 as the registry states: https://www.lakepowellchronicle.com redirects to https://lakepowellchronicle.com which serves 200 to curl with a browser UA. Its Creative Circle CMS serves article bodies in full at /stories/{slug},{id} (200, no paywall on the text); the legacy /article/{slug} path 403s at Varnish and /search, /search/, /searchresults all 404. This is now the single most productive Page source - use /stories/ URLs discovered via WebSearch. (3) NEW: Coconino County publishes results through app.enhancedvoting.com (e.g. /results/public/coconino-county-az/elections/07_P_2026); the shell loads but no JSON API endpoint was found. (4) page.suiteonemedia.com correctly avoided - not tried.

STRUCTURE SETTLED (the open question in the brief). cityofpage.org is WordPress and serves wp-json openly (robots.txt only disallows wp-admin/wp-includes) - this, not the city code, was the cheapest structural source, and it also carries the entire document corpus. Council = 7: an elected Mayor plus six at-large council members. FY2024 ACFR: 'The City Council is elected on a nonpartisan "at large" basis. Council members are elected to four-year staggered terms with three council members elected every two years.' FY2025 ACFR: 'consists of a Mayor and six Council Members'. Mayor is DIRECTLY ELECTED to a TWO-year term (city election page, 2026: 'William Diak / Mayor (2 year term)' against 'Councilmember (4 year term)'), so there is a mayoral cycle every even year. Vice Mayor is COUNCIL-SELECTED from among the members, not elected - proved negatively: the 2018 primary ballot carried only mayor, three 4-year council seats and two 2-year council seats, no vice-mayor race, yet John Kocjan was already Vice Mayor in the Oct 2018 budget book. Council-manager form (FY2024 budget book p.38). Terms run November to November. Municode has a Page AZ code (library.municode.com/az/page, 200) but was not needed; amlegal 403s.

Rung 7 (budgets/audit reports) carried this city. The wp-json MEDIA endpoint (media?search=<term>&per_page=100) surfaced an annual officials series not linked from any navigable page: ACFRs FY2021-FY2025 (each with a 'Members of City Council' page in the introductory section) and full budget books for FY2019, FY2021, FY2022, FY2024, FY2026 (each with a 'Mayor & City Council' portrait page carrying TERM-END YEARS, which is what let the stagger classes be reconstructed). The FY2019 budget book, dated 10-18-18, gives the pre-2018-election roster with per-seat term ends and is the anchor for the whole calendar. All extracted locally with pdftotext -layout. ACFR STALENESS CONFIRMED TWICE: the FY2023 ACFR (as of 30 Jun 2023) still lists Rick Yanke although Michael Farrow had replaced him in Nov 2022, and the FY2025 ACFR (as of 30 Jun 2025) reproduces the FY2024 officials page verbatim - William Diak as Mayor seven months after Steven Kidman took office. Neither was used where a dated primary record existed. Note also the FY2023 ACFR's officials page extracts with a broken font encoding (':LOOLDP'LDN' for 'William Diak').

City canvass resolutions are on the WP media endpoint but are IMAGE-ONLY SCANS - pdftotext returns nothing. The OCR path worked exactly as documented: pdftoppm -r 300 -png then tesseract --psm 4 -c preserve_interword_spaces=1, no reorientation needed. Resolution 1327-24 (canvass of the 5 Nov 2024 general) yielded verbatim per-precinct vote totals for three 4-year council seats AND for two recall seats. The site's resolution series only reaches back to 1310-23 (Nov 2023), so there are no canvass resolutions for 2018-2022.

Newspaper rung supplied every pre-2024 cycle. azdailysun.com (Arizona Daily Sun, Flagstaff) article of 28 Aug 2018 gave the 2018 primary in full. NOTE its body text is served ROT47-obfuscated inside kAm...k^Am wrappers (TownNews premium-content cipher); decoding is a two-line transform and yields the complete article. IMPORTANT: azdailysun.com/robots.txt name-blocks anthropic-ai and Claude-SearchBot with Disallow: / - one article was fetched before that was read; no further direct crawling of that host was done, and everything after came from WebSearch and from lakepowellchronicle.com. lakepowellchronicle.com/stories/ gave the 2022 primary, the 2024 mayoral race and the resignation record.

SIX mid-term changes found and dated. (1) Mark Cormier resigned 2 Mar 2020 (medical); David Auge appointed to complete the term to Nov 2022 - Auge is in the FY2021 budget book with 'Term ends November 2022'. (2) Theresa Lee resigned 14 May 2024 ('personal developments'). (3) Kenna Hettinger appointed 12 Jun 2024 to Lee's seat, term ending Nov 2026 (city press release, verbatim). (4) Brian Carey resigned 1 Aug 2024 after losing the mayoral primary, accepted 7 Aug 2024, with applications taken for an appointee to complete his term to Nov 2024. (5) RECALL ELECTION 5 Nov 2024 against councilors David Auge and Michael Farrow - both RETAINED (Auge 1,047 to Corey Ekstrand's 1,042, a 5-vote margin that triggered an automatic recount under A.R.S. 16-661; Farrow unopposed 1,572). This is invisible in any roster and was found only in the canvass resolution. (6) Councilor David Auge died 10 Jan 2026; former Vice Mayor John Kocjan was appointed to the vacancy in early 2026. The Lake Powell Chronicle's Carey story also supplies a decisive NEGATIVE check: 'Before 2024, the last councilor to resign before completing a full term was Mark Cormier' - which rules out any further undiscovered 2019-2023 mid-term change and is what makes the 100% coverage claim defensible.

CivicClerk: the registry host is right and the census floor is wrong in both directions. https://pageaz.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Events pages cleanly via @odata.nextLink (18 pages, 256 events, 75 of them City Council) and the earliest City Council event is 2024-06-12, not 2024 generally. But the documents are NOT reachable: /v1/Events({id}) and /v1/Events({id})/publishedFiles both 404, and /v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId={agendaId},plainText=true|false) returns HTTP 200 with a ZERO-BYTE body for every id tried. The Events records are still useful metadata - they confirmed meeting dates (Wed 7 Aug 2024, Wed 4 Dec 2024, Wed 25 Feb 2026) and carry externalMediaUrl pointing at meeting MP3s on cityofpage.org. Minutes roll call was therefore unavailable; it was not needed.

A.R.S. 9-821.01(D) TRAP CONFIRMED ACTIVE IN PAGE - this is not theoretical here. The Nov 2024 canvass resolution contains NO mayoral race at all, because Steven Kidman won the mayoralty outright at the 30 Jul 2024 primary (781 to Brian Carey's 483). The same happened in 2018 (all five council seats decided in the August primary; only the mayor went to November), 2022 (mayor and all three council seats decided 2 Aug 2022) and 2026 (mayor and all three council seats decided 21 Jul 2026). Recording a gap for any seat missing from a November ballot here would be wrong. IDENTITY: 'Theresa Bowlby' (2018 primary) and 'Theresa Lee' (2020-2024 records) are recorded as ONE person - not merged on surname (the surnames differ) but proved by elimination: the seat class matches, and the Chronicle states no councilor other than Cormier resigned mid-term before 2024, so no substitution could have occurred; the 2022 story calls Theresa Lee an incumbent. HOMONYM AVOIDED: 'Andrew Hettinger' in the budget books is the City Magistrate, unrelated to Councilor Kenna Hettinger. Day-of-week checked on every date: 2018-08-28, 2018-11-06, 2020-08-04, 2022-08-02, 2024-07-30, 2024-11-05, 2026-07-21 all Tuesdays; Tappan's oath 'Monday Nov. 26' 2018 is a Monday; the 2024-06-12, 2024-08-07, 2024-12-04 and 2026-02-25 council actions all fall on Wednesdays, matching Page's Wednesday meeting cycle in CivicClerk.

DATE-PRECISION CAVEATS (not gaps - the seat-years are unaffected). Seat labels A-F are a bookkeeping device: Page's council is purely at-large with no seat numbers, so seats are labelled by stagger class (A/B/C = elected 2018, 2022, 2026; D/E/F = elected 2020, 2024). Within a class the pairing of a 2024 winner to a specific predecessor is arbitrary. Seating dates: 2018 uses Tappan's sourced oath date 26 Nov 2018 for the whole slate; 2020 and 2022 use 1 Nov of the year because only the month is sourced ('Term Ends: November 20xx'); 2024 uses 4 Dec 2024, the date the recount finished with a 100% match and the date of the council special session. David Auge's 2020 appointment is dated to Cormier's resignation (2 Mar 2020) as a lower bound - the actual swearing date is not sourced. John Kocjan's 2026 appointment is dated 25 Feb 2026 as a bounded estimate: he is absent from the 14 Jan 2026 tribute meeting roster, the city posted its 'LOI Process for Council Vacancy' on 3 Feb 2026, and he appears on the current council page. Steven Kidman's Aug-Dec 2024 council tenure is the ONE low-confidence row in this file - the Chronicle records his 'brief experience as an appointed councilor' and Carey's seat was the only vacancy open in that window, but no document naming the appointee was retrieved. If it is wrong, the 2024 seat-year for At-Large D is still covered by Carey and Roundtree.

64 seat-year cells covered by tenures with zero gaps and zero known-vacant: 8 stable seat_labels (Mayor, Vice Mayor, At-Large A-F) x 8 years 2019-2026. The Vice Mayor is tracked as its own seat per the brief, so its 8 cells duplicate the council seat its holder also occupies (Kocjan/At-Large F to Dec 2024, Farrow/At-Large A after); the underlying body is 7 offices, i.e. 56 distinct seat-years. 24 tenure rows for 19 distinct people, 1 low-confidence row. Nothing recorded for the 21 Jul 2026 winners (Diak as mayor, Kocjan, Hettinger, Michael Cody Woods) because they are not seated until Nov 2026, which is in the future as of 17 Aug 2026 - winning is not holding.
